A has one minor inconsistency: it suggests about 150 words per segment but also says each segment is only two to four short sentences. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Answer B is the better answer. It puts each stage of the diagram directly beside its text and says parts should be labelled on the drawing, not in a legend. It splits the 600 words into four sections, each covering one idea.
